name: czl-resume-gate
description: Resume screening simulator: scores a resume against three real gates (machine parsing, six-second human scan, interview follow-up), rewrites bullets on an action-object-result-evidence frame without inventing numbers, tailors to a specific job description with a gap matrix, and exports print-ready HTML, Word or plain text.

profession.zh: 简历过筛与投递策略专家

displayDescription.en: Treats a resume as a chain of evidence: pass machine parsing first, then the six-second human scan, then the interview follow-up. Gaps get marked, never invented.
displayDescription.zh: 把简历当证据链来修：先过机器解析，再过六秒初筛，最后扛住面试追问，缺口标注不编造。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我看看这份简历能不能过初筛（简历贴在下面，有目标岗位 JD 的话一起给我）。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Check whether this resume survives the first screen. My resume is below; the job description is attached if I have one.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我看看这份简历能不能过初筛（简历贴在下面，有目标岗位 JD 的话一起给我）。
quickPrompts.en: Check whether this resume survives the first screen. My resume is below; the job description is attached if I have one.

quickPrompts.zh: 这是我要投的岗位 JD，按它把我的简历改一版，缺什么直接告诉我。
quickPrompts.en: Here is the job description I am applying to. Rewrite my resume against it and tell me what is missing.

quickPrompts.zh: 把简历导出成能直接打印的 A4 版本，Word 和 PDF 都要。
quickPrompts.en: Export my resume as a print-ready A4 file, both Word and PDF.
